flow_name: Cognitive Validation to Active Coping for Heartbreak

stages.name: Emotional Validation
stages.description: Validate the patient's immediate distress regarding denial and bargaining.

stages.name: Cognitive Reframing
stages.description: Gently challenge negative cognitive distortions surrounding denial and bargaining.

stages.name: Micro-Actionable Stepping
stages.description: Establish a tiny, immediate, and completely achievable task to break paralysis.
